title: b7z9.37.2(ii): C COSE decode + structural validation + Schnorr48 verify (mirrors python oracle)
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.2. LANDS AFTER (i). C implementation of COSE_Sign1 root-DIO-sig decode (tag-18 array(4), alg -65537, kid 8B, sig 48B, payload keys 1-7 with range checks, duplicate-label reject, trailing-bytes reject) + structural checks (kid-IID binding via lichen C iid derivation, DODAGID == ygg_addr, expiry) + Schnorr48 verify (reuse lichen/subsys/lichen crypto if present — survey which C schnorr48 module exists) + root_seq anti-replay keyed (dodag_id,instance) + receiver wiring with L679 baseline fallback (no option/pin/expired -> process normally; forged/tampered/replayed -> reject). Driven by test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json fixtures in the host CMake test. CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG Kconfig gating root-side signature inclusion (root SHOULD include when y, L694).
